descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use for tasks to look at, examine, or inspect an object under a lamp/desklamp (e.g. 'look at the book under the desklamp'): find the object, turn on the light, examine it.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for plain tasks to put/place/move ONE object in or on a receptacle (e.g. 'put a mug on the desk', 'put the apple in the fridge') with no heating, cooling, cleaning, or count of two.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the object must be cleaned/washed or is described as clean ('clean X', 'put a clean X in/on ...'): take it to the sink, wash with water, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the object must be cooled/chilled or is described as cool/cooled ('cool X', 'put a cooled X in/on ...'): use the fridge to cool it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the object must be heated/warmed/cooked or is described as hot/heated ('heat X', 'microwave X', 'put a hot X in/on ...'): use microwave/heat source, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task involves TWO objects or a plural ('two', 'both', 'put 2 pencils', bare plurals like 'put cds in the safe'): find and place both of the same kind in one receptacle.
